message: 相対的

name: Sally
message: 「I'm starving too! I wanna eat something!」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, it's already that time, huh」

name: Misa
message: 「Making such a foolish sound in the middle of Student Council activities is disgraceful as the Student Council President」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, the stomach that just growled wasn't Synn's--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You have terrible hearing, Vice President」

name: Misa
message: 「What did you say!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The one whose stomach just growled was Senpai」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehh」

name: Misa
message: 「The sound of Onee-sama's stomach... You must have gotten hungry from grueling task after grueling task」

name: Misa
message: 「A lovely humanity glimpsed even amidst perfection... It was a wonderful sound that completely captivated me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huge double standard for the exact same sound」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Um, you see\s01」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't lie, angel. That sound just now wasn't Ria-chan」

name: Paqy
message: 「If it were Ria-chan's, I could easily down three bowls of rice, but that one just now wouldn't even go down my throat」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm happy you're saying it wasn't me, but... I kinda hate how you put it\s02」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gasp」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I cannot deceive a specialist on Senpai, it seems. Truth be told, that sound just now was mine」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Stop making things more complicated!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the transport of bulky items to me, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte's butler, why are you here?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Just as my young lady instructed, when I placed a delivery order to the Student Council room with Yuugiri-an, Lady Nanaka's mother answered」

name: Riesling
message: 「She said everyone in the household is currently busy and cannot step away...」

name: Riesling
message: 「However, I heard that in the Student Council room at Ryuusei Academy, there is a fine soba maker who is every bit the master's equal.」

name: Riesling
message: 「And so, I was told to leave it to that person.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's a terrible way to put it after dumping this on me, honestly!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Your mother left a message: 'If that frustrates you, then make some delicious soba.'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't need to be told!」

name: Riesling
message: 「I was asked to bring a full set of soba-making tools and ingredients to the Student Council room.」
Riesling-san began setting up a full set of soba-making tools in the Student Council room, though where on earth she pulled them out from was anyone's guess.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Kuh. My hands are itching to get started!」

name: Misa
message: 「U-Um... I don't understand what's going on at all...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I thought it would be around the time everyone gets hungry, so I asked Jeeves to have food delivered.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It turned out a little differently than I expected, but this works out nicely too♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san! What are you thinking?! Ordering delivery during Student Council activities--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now, now, you can't fight on an empty stomach, right? And if we make it here, it doesn't even count as delivery.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not the issue here, is it!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I want everyone to try the soba I make, too.」
Faced with Nanaka's carefree, radiant smile, Misa falters.
Then, the moment she takes the soba knife in hand, her expression shifts to one of total seriousness, completely different from her usual self.
And then, she deftly works through making the soba.
Everyone in the Student Council finds themselves captivated by her brisk, practiced movements.
Every morning, Nanaka makes soba in my kitchen at home, looking every bit this lively.

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san... she's amazing.」

name: Synn
message: 「When Nanaka's making soba, she can't hear a thing.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's incredible concentration.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So exciting... I can't wait until it's finished~~\s07」

name: Sally
message: 「Uuu. I'm hungry~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here you go, sorry for the wait! Dig in!」

name: Sally
message: 「Smells amazing! This has gotta be Nanaka's soba!」

name: Misa
message: 「What have you even been watching up until now...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My stomach was getting tired of waiting.」

name: Ria
message: 「Is it really okay... for us to be treated to this?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Go right ahead! Feel free to ask for plenty of seconds!」
The way she wipes her forehead seems to shine.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you totally sick of it by now, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way! I could eat as much of your soba as you make, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heheh.」
She rubbed under her nose with a finger, looking bashful.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, thank you for the food~~ *slurp, slurp*」

name: Sally
message: 「Thanks for the meal! *Slurp*... Mmm, delicious!」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-This is...!!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's so good!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmph, blown away, aren't you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Plus, it's freshly made and boiled, so it's gotta be even tastier!」

name: Sally
message: 「Seconds!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Me too!」

name: Misa
message: 「With skill like this, wouldn't it be more than good enough to serve at the restaurant?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, my old man's is still way better. Hate to admit it, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「But you're gonna surpass him someday! Right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You bet I will!」

name: Ria
message: 「Wait, could the delicious soba shop Akane-chan was talking about be...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure she must've meant Yuugiri-an.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah. I'm sure that's it. They said they're a regular too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Uhm, I've never seen anyone like that」

name: Synn
message: 「So they're a regular」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Forget about that, eat up, eat up!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see... So this is truly it! When you eat a delicious dish at a restaurant... uhm, if I recall...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is what they mean by 'I seriously want to see the chef's face,' isn't it」

name: Ria
message: 「If you're going to say that, it's 'I'd like to give my compliments to the chef'\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, phrasing aside, as long as you think it's tasty, it's all good!」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez is so unfair, you know. Getting to eat soba this delicious every single day all this time」

name: Lolotte
message: 「All this time!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Every single!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Day!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, we're childhood friends, so...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's unfair」

name: Misa
message: 「How unfair」

name: Ria
message: 「Kinda unfair」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't deserve to be glared at so resentfully for that!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You say that, yet you aren't moved at all, President. Just 'tasty, tasty' as usual」

name: Ria
message: 「We were shocked, you know. Because it was our first time eating soba this delicious」

name: Misa
message: 「The soba I've had elsewhere was good too, but this was on a whole other level of exquisite」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You don't have to go that far...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, sure... I think the soba Nanaka makes is good, but... it's not like I get that emotional over it...」

name: Misa
message: 「To think someone with such a dull palate is the Student Council President! How lamentable!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, your sense of taste must be numb. How pitiful...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm... Even I don't think I can cover for you today.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't let it bother you, Nanaka! Even if Sakura-kun doesn't get it, the whole world is on your side!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I told you, I really don't mind. Synn doesn't know any compliment other than 'Delicious!' anyway.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That would be an insult to the JIS standards for soba!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You see, Synn-sama has never eaten any soba other than hers.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, that's right. So he just says 'Delicious!' like he always does.」
I see... Since Nanaka makes it for me every day, it naturally never showed up on our regular menu.

name: Misa
message: 「Why don't you try comparing it with what normal soba tastes like...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let's all make soba together!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「All right, I'm itching to show off my skills」

name: Ria
message: 「P-Paa-chan, you're making some too?」
And so, I slurp up the soba everyone made for me.

name: Synn
message: 「...Delicious!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha, knew you'd say that\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「But still... Nanaka's soba is the best!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Right, thanks♪」

name: Synn
message: 「...Sorry, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, wh-what's gotten into you all of a sudden」

name: Synn
message: 「I always thought it was good, but I never realized it was this amazing... I'm sorry!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, you don't need to go out of your way to apologize like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「From now on, I'll put my heart into every single bite when I eat your cooking.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, you don't have to go that far... though it does make me happy」

name: Misa
message: 「You really are too good-natured, Nanaka. If it were me, I'd tell him I'm never making soba for him again」

name: Ria
message: 「Good for you, Synn. Now you know just how delicious Nanaka's soba really is」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Before we knew it, this turned into a nice, heartwarming story, didn't it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Everyone, thank you too」

name: Misa
message: 「The pleasure is mine. Thank you for the meal」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you for the meal~」

name: Ria
message: 「It was super delicious」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, no, I'm just glad you liked it」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka... thank you for always continuing to make such delicious soba!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haha, stop it, you!」
Saying that, Nanaka smiled bashfully the entire time.
